children.zh-CN: 时间轴的节点，通常为 `Timeline.Item`；dataSource 非空时被忽略。
children.en-US: Timeline items, usually `Timeline.Item`. Ignored when dataSource is not empty.

className.en-US: Class name of the root `ul` element.

classNames.zh-CN: 内部各部位的类名，键为 `item`、`itemRail`、`itemIcon`、`itemContent`、`itemExtra`、`itemTime`，与组件自带的类名合并；`item` 落在每个 `li` 上，`itemRail` 是连接线，`itemIcon` 是圆点或自定义 dot 的容器；`item*` 键作用到全部 Timeline.Item，且在节点自己的 classNames 之前。
classNames.en-US: Class names of the inner parts, keyed by `item`, `itemRail`, `itemIcon`, `itemContent`, `itemExtra` and `itemTime`; merged with the built-in classes. `item` lands on every `li`, `itemRail` is the connecting line and `itemIcon` holds the dot or the custom dot; the `item*` keys apply to every Timeline.Item, before the item's own classNames.

styles.zh-CN: 内部各部位的内联样式，键同 `classNames`。
styles.en-US: Inline styles of the inner parts, keyed like `classNames`.

dataSource.zh-CN: 数据数组，非空时按数据渲染节点并忽略子节点；每项的属性与 Timeline.Item 相同，`content` 为节点内容。
dataSource.en-US: Data array. When it is not empty, the items are rendered from it and children are ignored. Each item takes the Timeline.Item props, with `content` as its content.

mode.zh-CN: 时间轴与内容的相对位置，可选 `left`、`right`、`center` 或 `alternate`。
mode.en-US: Position of the timeline relative to the content: `left`, `right`, `center` or `alternate`.

className.en-US: Class name of the root `li` element.

classNames.zh-CN: 内部各部位的类名，键为 `rail`、`icon`、`content`、`extra`、`time`，与组件自带的类名合并，在 Timeline 的 `item*` 类名之后；`rail` 是连接线，`icon` 是圆点或自定义 dot 的容器。
classNames.en-US: Class names of the inner parts, keyed by `rail`, `icon`, `content`, `extra` and `time`; merged with the built-in classes, after the `item*` class names of the Timeline. `rail` is the connecting line and `icon` holds the dot or the custom dot.

styles.zh-CN: 内部各部位的内联样式，键同 `classNames`，后于 Timeline 的 `item*` 样式写入。
styles.en-US: Inline styles of the inner parts, keyed like `classNames`, applied after the `item*` styles of the Timeline.

color.zh-CN: 圆点的背景色，覆盖 type 对应的颜色。
color.en-US: Background color of the dot, overriding the color of type.

dot.zh-CN: 自定义圆点内容，替换默认圆点。
dot.en-US: Custom dot content, replacing the default dot.

extra.zh-CN: 辅助说明内容，为空时不渲染；点击该区域不触发 onClick。
extra.en-US: Extra content, not rendered when empty. Clicks in this area do not trigger onClick.

position.zh-CN: 覆盖 Timeline 的 mode，指定该项位于 `left` 或 `right` 一侧。
position.en-US: Overrides the mode of the Timeline for this item: `left` or `right`.

time.zh-CN: 时间文本，为空时不渲染。
time.en-US: Time text, not rendered when empty.
